description: Source code for osp_unit_rdk module handling device info retrieval and version management, including serial, ID, model, firmware version, and hostname generation.

methods.name: osp_unit_serial_get
methods.description: Retrieves device serial number, caches result for subsequent calls.

methods.name: osp_unit_id_get
methods.description: Retrieves device ID, either serial number or MAC address depending on product requirement, with formatting.

methods.name: osp_unit_sku_get
methods.description: Returns false as SKU info is not available.

methods.name: osp_unit_model_get
methods.description: Retrieves device model number, caches result.

methods.name: osp_unit_sw_version_update_by_security_schema_rfc
methods.description: Adjusts firmware version string based on security schema and firmware version rules.

methods.name: osp_unit_sw_version_get
methods.description: Retrieves and possibly updates firmware version string.

methods.name: osp_unit_hw_revision_get
methods.description: Returns false as hardware revision info is not available.

methods.name: osp_unit_platform_version_get
methods.description: Retrieves platform software version, caches result.

methods.name: osp_unit_vendor_part_get
methods.description: Returns false as vendor part info is not available.

methods.name: osp_unit_manufacturer_get
methods.description: Returns false as manufacturer info is not available.

methods.name: osp_unit_factory_get
methods.description: Returns false as factory info is not available.

methods.name: osp_unit_mfg_date_get
methods.description: Returns false as manufacturing date info is not available.

methods.name: osp_unit_vendor_name_get
methods.description: Returns false as vendor name info is not available.

methods.name: osp_unit_dhcpc_hostname_get
methods.description: Generates DHCP client hostname based on serial number and model.
